per_candidate.id: s2:Peculiarities of pulsar pulse propagation in the solar corona
s2:Effects of the Intraday Variability of the Radio Galaxy Perseus A (3C 84)

rationale: The papers 'Radio emission across the entire rotation phases of pulsars', 'Radio Pulsar B0950+08: Radiation in Magnetosphere and Sparks above Surface', and 'Single Pulse Studies of PSR B0950+08 with FAST' provide insights into pulsar emission characteristics and variability, contributing evidence relevant to the nature of microsecond-scale fluence variability in pulsars.
